race.comment: STARBOARD (6) was up in class when failing to cop a heavy track at Eagle Farm a week ago. He can make full use of the pole position here, and with Bubba Tilley picking up the ride, a form reversal is on the cards. NORTH COURT (5) is a locally trained gelding who needed his resuming run at Warwick just over 5 weeks ago. All of his 3 career wins have been here, including a perfect 2 from 2 record over the trip. Stick with him. WANTED HILLBILLY (2) kept on fighting off a tough trip here 2 weeks ago, finishing second. Can win from a superior gate here. REDCLOUD (12) ran a better race for third here 2 weeks ago, and he should be thereabouts again in a limited field. FOUR ACE (1) has a good draw, and with the aid of a 3kg claim, he can be competitive at this level.
